evidence.detail: The class owns width/height, an int pixel buffer, a parallel float depth buffer, a BufferedImage backed directly by DataBufferInt over that pixel array, and the destination AWT Component.
Construction and reset bind its dimensions, pixel array and depth array into the shared rs/l/c software raster state.
Its draw method presents the backing BufferedImage through Graphics.drawImage at the requested coordinates and schedules R394 ClientWindowLayoutTask after first presentation.
The exact constructor shape (width,height,Component), direct int-buffer image backing and draw/present role match the long-standing RS client RSImageProducer class family.

candidates.note: Exact-v308 semantic recovery of the classic RSImageProducer rendering primitive; historical source is corroboration only.

evidence.detail: The class owns pixel array m, rendered width/height n/o, offsets p/q and max/canvas dimensions r/s plus numerous constructors from Image, byte[], cache archive and named image resources.
It implements direct, alpha, transformed, masked and scaled drawing into the shared software raster; it also supports image conversion, color replacement and dimension normalization.
Exact-v308 has roughly one hundred class references to rs/l/F across interfaces, overlays, fonts, particles and rendering, fixing it as the central client sprite primitive.
The cache-archive constructor and pixel/width/height/offset drawing contract match classic RS client Sprite source directly.

candidates.note: Exact-v308 semantic recovery of the classic Sprite rendering primitive; historical source is corroboration only.

evidence.detail: The constructor takes (boolean,String,rs/x/f), loads the named font data plus index.dat, allocates per-glyph byte masks and width/height/offset/advance arrays, and derives the font height.
The class provides string width measurement, left/right/centered text drawing, color/shadow variants, wave/jitter/randomized effects and low-level glyph blitting into the software raster.
Exact v308 preserves special named fonts hit_full and critical_full and otherwise allocates the classic 256-glyph font table.
The (boolean,fontName,archive) constructor, index.dat loader, Random field and glyph-array layout directly match classic RS client TextDrawingArea source.

candidates.note: Exact-v308 semantic recovery of the classic TextDrawingArea rendering primitive; historical source is corroboration only.
